primary_task: Inspect failing GitHub Actions checks on a PR with gh, fetch and summarize logs, draft a fix plan, and implement after approval.

requirements.name: gh
requirements.evidence: 'use `gh` to inspect checks and logs'; gh pr checks, gh run view --log, gh api

requirements.name: github (gh auth, repo+workflow scopes)
requirements.evidence: 'Run `gh auth status` in the repo ... (repo + workflow scopes are typically required)'
requirements.check: gh auth status; gh api -i user
requirements.observed: gh auth status: 'The token in GH_TOKEN is invalid'; but `gh api user` -> 200 login ginaecho, X-Oauth-Scopes: gist, read:org, repo, workflow (REST works via proxy)

requirements.name: api.github.com
requirements.evidence: gh pr checks / gh run view / gh api /repos/.../actions/jobs/<id>/logs
requirements.check: curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://api.github.com/; gh pr checks 1; gh api repos/<this repo>/actions/runs
requirements.observed: 200 for REST; gh pr list / gh pr checks / gh issue list -> 'HTTP 403: GitHub GraphQL is not available from Claude Code sessions; use the REST API'

notes: Partial: `gh pr checks`, `gh pr list` (and likely the bundled script, which wraps gh pr checks) hit GitHub GraphQL, which this session's proxy refuses (403). REST endpoints (gh run view, gh api repos/.../actions/...) work, and the github MCP (pull_request_read, actions_get, get_job_logs) is connected, so the workflow is achievable with REST substitutes. Also `gh auth status` reports the token invalid even though API calls succeed; a literal agent might stop at step 1. Repo must be attached to the session. Judged ACHIEVABLE but borderline.
